headline: GOLD DIVES $76 IN MONTH'S SHARPEST DROP: Treasury Yields Surge as April CPI Hits 3.8%
snippet: Gold fell $75.58 (-1.67%) to $4,438 and silver dropped 2.66% to $75.30 on May 27 — the sharpest single-session decline of the month — as U.S. Treasury yields climbed to near year-high levels and the dollar strengthened. Investors are pricing out rate-cut bets after April's CPI reading came in at 3.8%, the highest since May 2023.

headline: COPPER-GOLD HIT: LinQ Minerals' Maiden Monza Hole Delivers 70.8m @ 1.11% CuEq at NSW Gilmore Project
snippet: LinQ Minerals (ASX: LNQ) confirmed 70.8m @ 1.11% CuEq from 71.2m depth at the Monza prospect within the Gilmore Project (NSW), with a 10m high-grade core hitting 2.82% CuEq (1.57 g/t Au, 1.56% Cu). The system is open in multiple directions within one of Australia's premier Macquarie Arc porphyry belts, with 30,000m of drilling planned and results still pending.

headline: STACKED LODE EMERGING: Nexus Minerals Hits 26.53 g/t Gold at Clement Prospect, Wallbrook WA
snippet: All 10 of the first RC holes into Nexus Minerals' Clement prospect (Wallbrook, WA) returned anomalous gold, with a standout 12m @ 3.81 g/t including 1m @ 26.53 g/t confirming a stacked multi-lode mineralised system 140km northeast of Kalgoorlie. An updated multi-prospect mineral resource estimate is targeted for end of Q3 2026.

headline: NEVADA BEST HOLE: StrikePoint Drills 114m @ 0.69 g/t Au at Hercules — Oxide Heap-Leach Profile
snippet: StrikePoint Gold (TSX-V: SKP) reported H26-004 — 114.30m @ 0.69 g/t Au and 5.03 g/t Ag, including 9.14m @ 2.95 g/t Au — the best hole ever drilled at the Hercules Gold Project in Nevada's Walker Lane by grade-width. Dominantly oxide mineralisation is compatible with a heap-leach development model similar to other Walker Lane producers; a maiden resource is targeted for Q4 2026.

headline: ATHABASCA URANIUM HIT: Cosa Resources Confirms 1.7% U3O8 in Denison JV — Biggest Drill Plan to Follow
snippet: Chemical assays confirmed 1.7% U3O8 over 0.5m within a broader 5.0m interval averaging 0.55% U3O8 at Cosa Resources' Murphy Lake North project in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin — polymetallic uranium-nickel-cobalt mineralisation analogous in style to the Cigar Lake deposit. The JV with Denison Mines has prompted Denison to announce the largest drill program ever planned at the project.

headline: COLOMBIA DRILL START: GoldMining Inc. Begins 1,200m Campaign at Yarumalito Gold-Copper Project
snippet: GoldMining Inc. (TSX: GOLD) initiated diamond core drilling at its 100%-owned Yarumalito Gold-Copper Project in Colombia, launching a systematic 1,200m program to expand the geological dataset ahead of a resource update. The company holds a multi-asset Americas-wide exploration portfolio and is fully funded for the 2026 season.

headline: MAY 29 COUNTDOWN: Zijin's C$5.5B Allied Gold Takeover in Final Regulatory Hours Ahead of Outside Date
snippet: Zijin Gold International's C$5.5 billion all-cash (C$44/share) acquisition of Allied Gold Corp — covering three large African open-pit gold mines in Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia — has cleared shareholder and court approvals and is working through final multi-jurisdictional regulatory sign-offs with a May 29 outside closing date. If conditions remain outstanding at the deadline, the arrangement agreement provides for extension by the parties.

headline: SILVER: 6TH STRAIGHT DEFICIT YEAR as China Imports 790+ Tonnes — Structural Bull Case Intact
snippet: Silver enters its sixth consecutive year of structural supply deficit in 2026, with China importing over 790 tonnes in early 2026 driven by record solar panel production. Despite Wednesday's 2.7% session drop, the Gold SWOT column argues the underlying supply-demand math remains firmly bullish — industrial demand continues to outpace flat mine supply, with solar and EV applications absorbing inventory faster than producers can replace it.

headline: URANIUM AT $86/lb: Spot Climbs to 2-Month High as Utilities Move to Rebuild Fuel Stocks
snippet: Uranium futures rose to $86.5/lb on May 25 — near a two-month high — as utility contracting activity picks up ahead of the 2028 deadline for the full U.S. ban on Russian enriched uranium. The spot price remains below early-2026 highs near $100/lb but long-term contracting is accelerating visibly as Western utilities face a closing window to lock in non-Russian supply.

headline: BULLS UNMOVED: Goldman $5,400, JPMorgan $5,055 Gold Targets Hold Firm Despite May Correction
snippet: Goldman Sachs ($5,400 year-end), JPMorgan ($5,055 Q4), and UBS ($6,200) maintain elevated gold price targets even after gold's 16% correction from January's $5,589 all-time high to current levels near $4,438. Analysts cite 244 tonnes of central bank buying in Q1 2026 alone, persistent inflation at 3.8%, and structural de-dollarisation trends as evidence the May selloff is a correction within a multi-year bull — not a reversal.
